item.title: Pathways for eco-industrial transformations in the process industries: In search of enhanced inter- and intra-organizational innovation models and production solutions
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on how process industries can achieve ecological transformation through innovative organizational approaches and production methods. The collection seeks research examining both collaborative mechanisms between organizations and internal innovation strategies that drive sustainability in sectors like chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food processing, and other resource-intensive manufacturing.

The special issue welcomes contributions exploring novel business models, technological innovations, and organizational practices that enable process industries to reduce environmental impact while maintaining economic viability. Research addressing how companies can develop and implement enhanced production solutions within this context is particularly encouraged.

Appel publié par Technovation. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Eco-industrial transformation in process industries
  • Inter-organizational innovation models
  • Intra-organizational innovation models
  • Sustainable production solutions
  • Industrial ecology and symbiosis
  • Process industry sustainability
